og_title: IBJJF Rules: Scoring, Submissions & Weight Classes
description: Complete IBJJF rules reference for BJJ competitors. Scoring system, submission legality, weight classes, and prohibited techniques.
intro_paragraphs: The IBJJF (International Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Federation) ruleset is the most widely used competition format.
Understanding scoring is critical — many matches are decided by points, not submissions.

sections.heading: Overview
items: IBJJF rules govern most major BJJ tournaments including World Championships, Pans, and Worlds No-Gi.

items.text: No heel hooks, no toe holds, no knee reaping. Wrist locks legal.
Same as White, plus toe holds (Adult only).
All standard submissions. Heel hooks no-gi only (2021+ rule update).

faq.question: Can I do heel hooks at IBJJF white belt no-gi?
faq.answer: No. Heel hooks are only legal at brown and black belt no-gi divisions in IBJJF.

faq.question: What's the time limit for adult black belt matches?
faq.answer: 10 minutes regulation. Sudden victory overtime if tied.
